opening.argument: A uniformed speaker at a conference explains a mobile landing platform in concrete operational terms: its flight deck, the aircraft and drones it could accommodate, and its construction status. The stated “$100 million more” is the cost of adding a flight deck to the same tanker, not a payment requested from viewers. The speaker says the platform is under contract, in construction, and about half done, without claiming it is already complete. Nothing in the presentation describes viewer participation, an investment return, a credential request, or a payment destination. The amount and capabilities are presented as part of an explanation of a military platform, not an offer to the audience.

citations.quote: For $100 million more, you get a flight deck on this same Alaskan tanker
you can put CH-53, Big Hilo, all kinds of drones
This one is under contract. It's in construction. It's about half done
Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) Adm. Jonathan Greenert talks about the Afloat Forward Staging Base during the McAleese/Credit Suisse Defense Conference.
